facility.name: Helen Marie's Christian Childcare

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Notification of Changing Address or Location: The operation changed addresses without approval of Child Care Regulation.    Corrected: This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Changing Address or Location (26 TAC §746.301(1))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: The use zone in front and behind the slide is under 6 feet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The health inspection was last conducted on 07/14/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was observed alone in the office with the door closed. This was corrected at inspection when the child was brought back into the group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity: There were 9 children in care. This was corrected at inspection when the director sent one chld home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))

occurrences.finding: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity: There were 12 children in care. This was corrected at inspection when the director sent home five children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four of four staff did not have training in responding to food allergies, emergency preparedness, understanding building safety, or handling and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Four of four staff have current CPR training that did not include hands-on use of a CPR manakin.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: Daily snack menu was not posted     Note: 	This was corrected at inspection copy was completed and  provided of the snack menu.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: Written activity plan posted was not being followed during inspection.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when an updated activity plan was posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: Written activity plan posted was not being followed during inspection.  Note: This was corrected at inspection when lunch was served during the time listed in the activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The operation reduced indoor and outdoor space without notifying Child Care Regulation. This was corrected at inspection when a discussion was had with the director on required notifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Two of five children's files could not be located.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: The director's CPR and FIrst Aid certificate is expired. Another employee's CPR was online only.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: The infant cribs were not labeled. This was corrected at inspection when the cribs were labeled with the child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: An infant who is not yet on table food did not have current infant feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Two children under two were observed watching a screen.    Corrected at inspection: The operation immediately turned off the tablet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The annual fire inspection was last conducted on March 14, 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: The operation serves snacks. The menu was not posted listing the items that are served.    Corrected at inspection: The operation posted the menu during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director did not ensure staff are following minimum standards, when staff failed to communicate with parent that a child was not bringing meals, since the daycare does not provide meals.  The director did not ensure operational policies were updated, to reflect that the center does not provide meals, and the center only provides snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Nutritional Value: The operation did not have a signed statement from the parent acknowledging the child care center was not responsible for meeting the child's daily food needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Nutritional Value (26 TAC §746.3309(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Regular Meals and Snacks: Based on information gathered, it was determined a 13 month infant ready for table food was not feed table food for three days that the child attended daycare.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Regular Meals and Snacks (26 TAC §746.3301(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information gathered, it was determined that staff did not practice good judgement when staff did not communicate with parent that infant did not bring meals for three days that the child attended and infant only drank milk and snacks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Notify Parents of Change in Operational Policy or Enrollment Agreement: During the time of inspection it was observed that the operational policies were not updated to reflect the center does not provide meals, and center only provides snacks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notify Parents of Change in Operational Policy or Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.505(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: A fire drill was not completed in the month of September. This was corrected at inspection when a fire drill was conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher was last serviced in 9/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: There were 11 children in care with one caregiver. Six of the 11 children were infants under the age of 18 months. This was corrected at inspection when the director returned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One of three staff did not have current CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant caregiver had seven children by herself. This was corrected at inspection when a child was sent home and the center was able to operate under standard 746.1705.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Infant feeding instructions were not up to date for the four infants not on table food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An 11-month-old child was observed sleeping with in a crib with a blanket. A six-month-old was observed sleeping in a crib with a blanket and a bib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Two of three staff files did not have a signed affidavits.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Two three-month-old children were observed sleeping in restrictive devices. This was corrected at inspection when the children were removed and placed in cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification: One of three staff files audited did not have a copy of a photo ID.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(8))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation failed to submit the number of employees that have left their employment in 2023 by January 15th.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: An infant who is not yet on table food did not have signed and dated infant feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: Infant daily sheets were not  being filled ouit.  This was corrected at inspections when the director started filling out the sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: Cribs were not labeled with each child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Two of three personnel files did not have proof of First Aid and CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Two of three personnel files do not have any information other than the name of the caregiver. All items listed under 746.901 need to be complete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two of four children's records did not have a completed health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing a diaper. This was corrected at inspection when the director instructed the employee to wash their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver did not wash the hands of the child after changing their diaper. This was corrected at inspection when the director instructed the employee to wash the child's hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: Carbon monoxide detectors have not been inspected since opening on 4/11/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: No severe weather drills have been recorded since opening on 4/11/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The caregiver left in charge at the operation did not have a current background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Caregiver Must Face Child and Be Within Arm's Length of Child: A caregiver was observed walking away from a child who was on the diaper changing table. The caregiver walked to the other side of the room with their back to the child and was not within arms reach. This was corrected at inspection when the director went to secure the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Caregiver Must Face Child and Be Within Arm's Length of Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An infant less than a 12 months old was observed sleeping in a crib with a blanket, pacifier tied to a cord, and a bib tied around their neck. The items were removed by the director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products-Posting of CPSC website: The CPSC form was not available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products-Posting of CPSC website (26 TAC §746.4135(c))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: No fire drills have been recorded since opening on 4/11/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Crib Mattress Cover - Designed for Use in Size and Type of Crib: A child was standing in a crib that did not have a sheet designed for the mattress. This was corrected at inspection when the child and sheet were removed from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Crib Mattress Cover - Designed for Use in Size and Type of Crib (26 TAC §746.2415(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System Tested: No smoke detector inspections have been conducted since opening on 4/11/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System Tested (26 TAC §746.5315)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: A bottle with formula was being stored on the diaper changing mat. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver removed the bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Children were observed napping on cots that were not assigned by name or number.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Napping Floor Mats Marked with Sleeping Side Distinguished: Mats were observed being used without designated floor and sleep sides.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Napping Floor Mats Marked with Sleeping Side Distinguished (26 TAC §746.4503(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: The health inspection expired 4/26/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One of six children's files did not have an emergency care authorization on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: One of six children's files did not have anyone besides the parents authorized to pick up the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: One of six children's files did not have an enrollment date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: Activity plans identifying the age group the activity plan is designed for and period the plan covers were not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two of six children's files did not have a current health care provider statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Infant feeding instructions are not on file for the two infants not on table food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: The personnel file for the only employee does not exist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One of six children's files did not have an address for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The children were left unsupervised when the only caregiver left the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Four of six children's files did not have current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Five of six children's files did not complete the special needs care statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Two of six children's files did not have health care information on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit was missing scissors, tweezers, disposable gloves, a guide to first aid, gauze, and tape,
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies did not include a statement promoting indoor and outdoor physical activivties.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
